purpose: Post-hoc rare-label and confidence diagnostics of the frozen seed101 model on existing shots; no tuning or retraining

definitions.analysisStatus: Post-hoc descriptive; all bins/thresholds fixed in source before processing this analysis, after parent results were known. No fitting or threshold optimization.
definitions.confidence: max(P(observable flip), 1-P(observable flip)); confidence in the predicted binary class, distinct from event probability
definitions.confidenceBinMembership: Lower-inclusive, upper-exclusive except final bin includes1
definitions.coverage: selected count / all shots at that condition
definitions.selectiveRisk: mistakes / selected count for confidence >= threshold; thresholds overlap and are not independent experiments
definitions.emptyGroups: count/failures0, coverage0, error/interval/confidence/accuracy null, never inferred as perfect accuracy
definitions.eventGap: mean predicted flip probability minus observed flip frequency; positive=overprediction of flips, not necessarily overconfidence
definitions.constantBaseline: Probability estimated ONLY from original training labels, held fixed on all original and confirmation test conditions
definitions.alwaysNoFlip: Predicts logical flip0 at threshold0.5; Brier equals observed flip prevalence
definitions.intervals: Pointwise95% Wilson intervals for conditioned error rates, conditional on frozen model and simulator; not simultaneous bands, no inferential significance claim
definitions.brierDecomposition: Not reported: fixed-bin coarsening changes the predictions and an exact original-score Murphy decomposition would require residual terms
definitions.reproductionTolerance: All failure counts, decisions, sample counts, bin counts and Wilson intervals exactly equal stored results; Brier/probability summaries absolute tolerance2e-7 to allow float32 GEMM rounding
definitions.dataReuse: Reuses all80,000 original test shots and400,000 confirmation shots plus40,000 original training labels; no new independent evidence or training replication
definitions.causalLimit: The measurement-noise sweep changes task difficulty and training mismatch together. Without separately retrained matched-noise neural models it does not isolate the causal cost of mismatch alone.
